summary.text: Aurora Stuski is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 4th District and a West Norriton, Montgomery County business owner. She is the founder and owner of AAS Appraisal Lab, a jewelry and collectibles appraisal business, and has held local Republican Party roles since 2022. According to her campaign website, her platform centers on limited government, lower taxes on homeowners, and community safety.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Stuski grew up in Philadelphia and moved to West Norriton, Montgomery County, in 1987, where she has lived for more than 35 years and raised three children.
Her campaign website lists a Bachelor of Fine Arts from Arcadia University with a minor in business administration, and Ballotpedia dates the Arcadia degree to 1988.
The website also lists a Graduate Gemologist credential from the Gemological Institute of America.
Earlier in her career, Stuski worked in the architectural field on proposal development and accounts receivable for a national firm that builds hospitals and healthcare facilities.

She is founder and owner of AAS Appraisal Lab, which has served Montgomery County since 1989 and offers appraisals of jewelry, coins and collectibles, expert witness testimony, estate valuation and insurance claim arbitration.
Her campaign site says she volunteered on Ernie Preate's 1989-1995 Attorney General campaign and on Kathy Barnette's congressional and Senate campaigns in 2019-2021.

It lists her party roles as West Norriton Republican Committee chair and Montgomery County Republican Committee Area 8 vice chair (both 2024-present), West Norriton committee person (2022-present), and an elected delegate to the Republican National Convention from the 4th District; it also lists past runs for county commissioner and West Norriton commissioner.
She serves as a board member of West Norriton United, a community civic organization.
